observation.visible_scene: A nighttime outdoor clearing with a campfire built as a pyramid/teepee of stacked logs burning in the center. Foreground is green grass with a worn dirt patch around the fire; a line of dark pine trees stands against a deep blue night sky, and a pile of grey rocks sits to the right of the fire.
visible_changes: The flames flicker and change shape frame to frame, with the bright yellow-orange core and surrounding tongues of fire expanding and contracting without a fixed pattern.
Small bright sparks/streaks appear above the flames and drift upward at varying heights and horizontal positions across the sequence.
A faint column of smoke rises above the fire, its density and tilt shifting slightly between frames.
The glowing embers on the log pile remain largely steady in position, with minor changes in brightness.
The log structure, rock pile, trees, grass and sky keep the same positions relative to the frame edges throughout, indicating a fixed viewpoint.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the fire was lit and whether it will continue, die down, or be tended after this segment.
Events before t=0 and after t=1.33s that are not shown.
uncertain_details: Whether the apparent upward movement of sparks reflects true particle motion or frame-to-frame sampling of a rising plume; the overall upward trend is visible but individual spark trajectories cannot be traced.
Any very slight camera shake cannot be confirmed because background landmarks remain essentially fixed.
